done_when: When replaying a stacked part or follow-up fix onto the default branch conflicts, close names forge work <item> to merge the default branch, then forge close <item>, and names no rebase or force push
why: Close's replay-conflict refusal tells the agent to rebase and force-push, but Forge's own hook blocks that push, so a person must use a terminal (Forge issue 1292). Merging the default branch into the branch already works: close skips the replay when origin/<default> is an ancestor of HEAD.
